svg.title: The lifecycle in detail: who does what at each stage
svg.desc: Nine lifecycle stages as columns and the roles as lanes, with the actions each role performs and the decisions and sign-offs at each stage.
svg.text: The lifecycle in detail: who does what at each stage
The full track: nine stages as columns, the roles as lanes; sign-offs marked Enhanced apply to Significant changes only. The component track runs along the bottom.

COMPONENT TRACK · models, tools, MCP servers and APIs, skills, knowledge sources
Six of the nine stages; governed
Assets that depend on it told
Internal Audit can read the whole record, as it stood on any date, at any stage. The governance solution routes each task, reminds, and records every decision with who, when and on what evidence.
On the Light path gates 1 and 2 can be decided together. A substantial modification or a new use is rated again and passes the gates of its path again (8.7). Details: sections 5 to 9 and Appendix B.
